title: Multi-Container Application State
objective: Coordinate application, database, network, and persistent storage resources.

sourceAlignment.title: Ansible for DevOps, 2nd Edition
sourceAlignment.author: Jeff Geerling
sourceAlignment.note: Original Code Forge companion material; no book prose is reproduced.

paragraphs: A containerized stack separates application and database processes, attaches them to a private network, and stores durable database state in a volume.
Ansible collection modules can build images and converge networks, volumes, and containers. Pin image versions, protect credentials, add health checks, and make dependency readiness explicit.
explanation.rule: Operational rule: Coordinate application, database, network, and persistent storage resources.

examples.title: Working design artifact
examples.code:
container_stack:
  app_image: codeforge/flask:1.0
  database_image: mysql:8.4
  network: private
  data: managed_volume
  health_checks: required
examples.note: Use this as a reasoning model before applying changes to the disposable lab.
